CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False

Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True

Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_Close()
    Msg = "This will add a fee record for all cuurent student.  This function is only applied once a month. Please select Y to contine."
    varResponse = InputBox(Msg)
    If varResponse = "Y" Then
        DoCmd.SetWarnings False
        DoCmd.OpenQuery "qryFeesMonthlyDueUpload_S3"
Rem        DoCmd.DeleteObject acTable, "tmptblFeesMonthlyDueUpload"
        DoCmd.SetWarnings True
    End If
End Sub
